title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
abstract: arXiv:2608.20958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: E-commerce live streaming requires omni-modal understanding of noisy, temporally extended streams, where product facts are distributed across speech, video frames, product images, overlaid text, and user queries. We present TLive-Omni, an omni-modal understanding model tailored to live-commerce scenarios. It maps image, video, audio, and text inputs into a unified representation space. For long-form live streaming analysis, we introduce Per-vGrid, a timestamped token organization that groups each video grid with its temporally corresponding audio within explicit boundary tokens to facilitate temporal alignment. We design a three-stage supervised training recipe that progressively develops live-commerce understanding, from omni-modal perception to instruction-following responses. We then propose Faithful-RFT, a reinforcement fine-tuning stage that further improves answer faithfulness and expression quality while meeting real-time demands,

translated_title: TLive-Omni：面向电商直播的全模态理解模型
translated_abstract: 电商直播需要对嘈杂、时间跨度长的流媒体进行全模态理解，其中产品事实分布在语音、视频帧、产品图片、叠加文本和用户查询中。我们提出了TLive-Omni，一个专为直播电商场景定制的全模态理解模型。它将图像、视频、音频和文本输入映射到一个统一的表示空间。针对长时间直播流分析，我们引入了Per-vGrid，一种带时间戳的令牌组织方式，将每个视频网格与其时间上对应的音频在明确的边界令牌内分组，以促进时间对齐。我们设计了一个三阶段的监督训练流程，从全模态感知到指令跟随响应，逐步发展直播电商理解能力。随后，我们提出了Faithful-RFT，一个强化微调阶段，进一步提高答案的忠实度和表达质量，同时满足实时性需求。
tldr: 该论文提出TLive-Omni模型，通过Per-vGrid时间戳组织和三阶段训练及Faithful-RFT强化微调，实现对电商直播中多模态信息的统一理解和实时、忠实的响应生成。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TLive-Omni, which leverages Per-vGrid timestamped token organization and a three-stage training with Faithful-RFT to achieve unified omni-modal understanding and real-time faithful responses in e-commerce live streaming.
